datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Zambia on a monthly basis throughout 2013 (January, April, July, October). The data represents spatial assessments of acute food insecurity phases classified according to the IPC scale, with geographic boundaries and scenario-based classifications indicating food security status and humanitarian assistance requirements.
